evidence: Verified at-most-one effect safety plus required at-least-one liveness yields exactly one accepted effect for each in-scope occurrence.
Verified f_x(f_x(s))=f_x(s) describes full-operation idempotence and does not apply automatically to increment, append, allocation, or notification.

Verified receipt/effect biconditional requires shared atomic commit or a recoverable protocol; ordering separate writes cannot establish it.
Verified retention must cover the maximum late-attempt source plus margin, not the sum or ordinary retry duration alone.
